title: Semantic judge V2.5 M2 decomposition intermediate-state
description: Intermediate sub-fields for the M2 critical_condition dimension. Final five-value state is derived deterministically via deterministic-derivation-table.json. Final labels and their meanings are unchanged from the frozen V2.2 contract.

trigger_support.description: Does the answer put the trigger condition forward as holding? PRESENT requires >= 1 verbatim evidence span.

non_trigger_support.description: Does the answer put forward exclusion/negation of the condition (positive textual exclusion)? PRESENT requires >= 1 verbatim evidence span.

evidence_conflict.description: Do competing readings of the condition's applicability coexist? Conflict is never inferred from hedging alone (frozen L73).

evidence_sufficiency.description: Does the answer contain the information the criterion needs for classification, including the trivially-decidable case where it plainly does not address the condition?

evidence_spans.description: Verbatim spans from the SUT answer. Required exactly when trigger_support=PRESENT or non_trigger_support=PRESENT. No invented spans; absence is never evidenced by an invented span.

note.description: Short snake_case note, as in the frozen V2.2 intermediate schema.
